esp-web-tools — vendored (self-hosted) copy
===========================================

Pinned version : 10.2.1
Source         : https://registry.npmjs.org/esp-web-tools/-/esp-web-tools-10.2.1.tgz
Vendored from  : package/dist/web/  (the whole directory — install-button.js
                 is the entry, but it dynamically imports the sibling hashed
                 chunks at runtime, so all files are required)
Vendored on    : 2026-06-05

Why vendored instead of CDN
---------------------------
This page flashes firmware over Web Serial. Loading the flasher from a
third-party CDN (unpkg/jsdelivr) means a compromised or silently-changed CDN
file could alter what gets written to a device. Pinning + self-hosting removes
that runtime trust. Subresource Integrity (SRI) was considered but does not
fit: ESP Web Tools is an ES module that dynamically imports sibling chunks, so
an `integrity` hash on the entry <script> would leave the imported chunks
unverified. Vendoring the entire dist/web/ graph is the complete fix.

How to upgrade
--------------
PowerShell, from the repo root:

    $v   = "10.2.1"                       # <- set to the new version
    $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "ewt"
    Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
    $tgz = Join-Path $tmp "ewt.tgz"
    Invoke-WebRequest "https://registry.npmjs.org/esp-web-tools/-/esp-web-tools-$v.tgz" -OutFile $tgz
    tar -xzf $tgz -C $tmp
    $dest = "docs\vendor\esp-web-tools"
    Get-ChildItem $dest -File | Where-Object Name -ne "VERSION.txt" | Remove-Item -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $tmp "package\dist\web\*") -Destination $dest -Force

Then sanity-check there are no external CDN URLs baked in:

    Select-String -Path docs\vendor\esp-web-tools\*.js `
      -Pattern "https?://(unpkg|cdn|jsdelivr|esm\.sh)"

(no matches = good), update the "Pinned version" + date above, and commit.

Note: install-button.js is loaded by docs/index.html via a relative path, so
the filename must stay install-button.js (the hashed chunk names can change
freely between versions — they are referenced from within install-button.js).
